info.title: Autodesk Machine Control Framework - API Documentation
info.description: This is an OpenAPI 3.0 specification of the Autodesk Machine control Framework's Server API.

externalDocs.description: Find out more about the Autodesk Machine Control Framework on github

tags.name: data
tags.description: Data endpoints for queries and streams (logs, executions, alerts, configurations, and binary data payloads)

tags.name: general
tags.description: General API end points, data exchange

post.description: Creates a new session and starts an authentication flow with the given user name. If user does not exist, the call will not fail but return random values in order to protect the service from a discovery attack.

post.summary: Authenticate a session with the proper challenge response mechanism.
post.description: As second step of the authentication process, it uses the return values of a call to '/auth' and sends a computed response back in order to authenticate the session with the user's password.

get.summary: Query the protocol version
get.description: Returns the version of the protocol (to be implemented)

get.summary: Retrieve UI configuration
get.description: Returns the server-provided UI configuration used to bootstrap the active web client.

get.summary: List state machine instances
get.description: Returns all configured state machine instances with their current state.

get.summary: Retrieve details of one state machine instance
get.description: Returns one state machine instance including parameter groups and parameter values.

get.summary: Retrieve build list of the system
get.description: Retrieves build list from server, either the build which are currently in use or have been archived.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific build

post.description: Updates a build item's status or name.

post.summary: Retrieve toolpath segments for one layer
post.description: Returns the geometric segment data for a specific layer of a build job.

get.summary: Retrieve log entries
get.description: Returns the latest log entries (up to 128). Supports incremental polling when used with the startID path parameter.

get.summary: Retrieve log entries after a given ID
get.description: Returns log entries with an ID greater than startID. Use for incremental polling by passing the highest ID received so far.

parameters.name: startID
parameters.description: The log entry ID to start from (exclusive). Only entries after this ID are returned.

get.summary: Retrieve job execution list
get.description: Returns all build job executions with their status, timestamps, and duration.

get.summary: Retrieve alert list
get.description: Returns all alerts including their level, context, and acknowledgement status.

get.summary: Retrieve configuration version list
get.description: Returns all configuration versions for a given schema. The schema query parameter is required to identify the configuration type.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The configuration schema identifier to query versions for.

get.summary: Download binary data by download ticket
Retrieve an image resource by UUID
get.description: Returns the binary image data for a given resource UUID. Looks up the resource in the core resource package first, then falls back to storage. This endpoint does not require authentication because images are typically loaded by HTML img tags that cannot send Bearer tokens.

parameters.name: imageUUID
parameters.description: UUID of the image resource to retrieve

200.description: The binary image data with the appropriate content type.

get.summary: Retrieve point cloud as binary float buffer

Retrieve mesh face geometry as binary float buffer

200.description: Binary float32 stream containing triangle vertices

get.summary: Retrieve mesh edge geometry as binary float buffer

200.description: Binary float32 stream containing edge line segments
